question: How many open shipping-related support tickets do our strategic accounts have in total?

input.purpose: Check tier values and active accounts in Salesforce to define strategic accounts
input.sql: SELECT tier_c, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN _fivetran_active THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_n, SUM(CASE WHEN is_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deleted_n FROM salesforce.account GROUP BY tier_c ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check ticket status, type, priority values
input.sql: SELECT status, type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM zendesk.ticket WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY status, type ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check zendesk organization and ticket tags for linking to accounts and shipping topic
input.sql: SELECT tag, COUNT(*) AS n FROM zendesk.ticket_tag WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY tag ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

input.purpose: Look at zendesk organization linkage fields
input.sql: SELECT id, name, external_id, _fivetran_deleted FROM zendesk.organization ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

input.purpose: Check Salesforce account history duplicates and whether Zendesk org external_id matches Salesforce account id
input.sql: SELECT a.id, a.name, a.tier_c, a._fivetran_active, a._fivetran_start, a._fivetran_end, a.is_deleted, o.id AS zd_org_id, o.name AS zd_name FROM salesforce.account a LEFT JOIN zendesk.organization o ON o.external_id = a.id WHERE a.tier_c = 'Strategic' ORDER BY a.name, a._fivetran_start

input.purpose: Count open tickets by tag and status family to define shipping-related scope
input.sql: SELECT t.status, tt.tag, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS n FROM zendesk.ticket t LEFT JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag tt ON tt.ticket_id = t.id AND NOT tt._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT t._fivetran_deleted GROUP BY t.status, tt.tag ORDER BY t.status, n DESC

input.purpose: Check account history for Quenmere and the 2026-09-22 batch of Strategic accounts
input.sql: SELECT id, name, tier_c, region_c, _fivetran_active, _fivetran_start, _fivetran_end, is_deleted, _fivetran_synced FROM salesforce.account WHERE name IN ('Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH','Thalmark Marine Srl','Velmere Pipeline Services Ltd','Vornwick Utilities Inc') OR _fivetran_start >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY name, _fivetran_start

input.purpose: List all open tickets (new/open/pending/hold) for Strategic accounts with tags and subjects
input.sql: WITH strat AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.id AS org_id, a.name FROM salesforce.account a JOIN zendesk.organization o ON o.external_id = a.id WHERE a.tier_c = 'Strategic' AND a._fivetran_active AND NOT a.is_deleted) SELECT t.id, s.name, t.status, t.priority, t.type, t.created_at, t.subject, string_agg(tt.tag, ',') AS tags FROM zendesk.ticket t JOIN strat s ON s.org_id = t.organization_id LEFT JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag tt ON tt.ticket_id = t.id AND NOT tt._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT t._fivetran_deleted AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY s.name, t.created_at

input.purpose: Recompute the open shipping-related ticket count for current Strategic accounts with a corrected query
input.sql: WITH strat AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.id AS org_id, a.name FROM salesforce.account a JOIN zendesk.organization o ON o.external_id = a.id WHERE a.tier_c = 'Strategic' AND a._fivetran_active AND NOT a.is_deleted), tk AS (SELECT t.id, t.status, t.subject, s.name, COALESCE(string_agg(tt.tag, ','), '') AS tags FROM zendesk.ticket t JOIN strat s ON s.org_id = t.organization_id LEFT JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag tt ON tt.ticket_id = t.id AND NOT tt._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT t._fivetran_deleted AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold') GROUP BY t.id, t.status, t.subject, s.name), flagged AS (SELECT *, (tags ~ 'shipping|delivery|logistics|late_delivery') AS tag_ship, (lower(subject) ~ 'deliver|ship|track|late|arriv|warehouse|not received|missing|delay') AS subj_ship FROM tk) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tag_ship OR subj_ship) AS shipping_open_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tag_ship) AS tag_only, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (tag_ship OR subj_ship) AND status = 'open') AS status_open_only, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (tag_ship OR subj_ship) AND status IN ('pending','hold','new')) AS pending_hold_new, COUNT(DISTINCT name) FILTER (WHERE tag_ship OR subj_ship) AS accounts_with_any, COUNT(*) AS all_open_strategic_tickets FROM flagged

input.purpose: Debug: list each open Strategic ticket with its tag and subject-keyword flags to verify the count
input.sql: WITH strat AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.id AS org_id, a.name FROM salesforce.account a JOIN zendesk.organization o ON o.external_id = a.id WHERE a.tier_c = 'Strategic' AND a._fivetran_active AND NOT a.is_deleted), tk AS (SELECT t.id, t.status, t.subject, s.name, COALESCE(string_agg(tt.tag, ','), '') AS tags FROM zendesk.ticket t JOIN strat s ON s.org_id = t.organization_id LEFT JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag tt ON tt.ticket_id = t.id AND NOT tt._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT t._fivetran_deleted AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold') GROUP BY t.id, t.status, t.subject, s.name) SELECT id, name, status, subject, tags, regexp_matches(tags, 'shipping|delivery|logistics|late_delivery') AS tag_ship, regexp_matches(lower(subject), 'deliver|ship|track|late|arriv|warehouse|not received|missing|delay') AS subj_ship FROM tk ORDER BY name, id

input.purpose: Verify the count of open shipping-related tickets for current Strategic accounts using explicit tag and subject rules with regexp_matches
input.sql: WITH strat AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.id AS org_id, a.name FROM salesforce.account a JOIN zendesk.organization o ON o.external_id = a.id WHERE a.tier_c = 'Strategic' AND a._fivetran_active AND NOT a.is_deleted), tk AS (SELECT t.id, t.status, t.subject, s.name, COALESCE(string_agg(tt.tag, ','), '') AS tags FROM zendesk.ticket t JOIN strat s ON s.org_id = t.organization_id LEFT JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag tt ON tt.ticket_id = t.id AND NOT tt._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT t._fivetran_deleted AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold') GROUP BY t.id, t.status, t.subject, s.name), f AS (SELECT *, regexp_matches(tags, 'shipping|delivery|logistics|late_delivery') AS tag_ship, regexp_matches(lower(subject), 'order .* (arrived late|not received|still missing)|left your warehouse|tracking not updating|shipment|late delivery|delivery for order') AS subj_ship FROM tk) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tag_ship OR subj_ship) AS shipping_open_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tag_ship) AS tag_rule, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (tag_ship OR subj_ship) AND status='open') AS status_open, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (tag_ship OR subj_ship) AND status IN ('pending','hold','new')) AS status_pending_hold_new, COUNT(DISTINCT name) FILTER (WHERE tag_ship OR subj_ship) AS accounts FROM f

answer.answer_summary: Torvane's 26 current Strategic accounts have 27 open shipping-related support tickets in total (13 with status open, 14 pending, on hold or new). These cover 16 of the 26 accounts. One untagged "Delay on bearings" ticket was left out as unclear, and the count would be 25 if the three accounts re-tiered to Strategic on 22 Sep 2026 were excluded.

metrics_used.name: Open shipping-related Strategic-account tickets
metrics_used.definition: Count of Zendesk tickets with status new/open/pending/hold, linked to a current Strategic Salesforce account, and tagged shipping/delivery/logistics/late_delivery or with a subject describing a delivery, tracking, late arrival or missing shipment. Untagged ambiguous 'delay' tickets excluded.

metrics_used.name: Strategic account
metrics_used.definition: Salesforce account with tier_c = 'Strategic', _fivetran_active = true, is_deleted = false (26 accounts).

lineage: zendesk.ticket + zendesk.ticket_tag -> open shipping-related filter; zendesk.organization (external_id) -> salesforce.account (tier_c = Strategic) -> open shipping-related ticket count
assumptions: Strategic accounts = Salesforce accounts with tier_c = 'Strategic', active, not deleted (26 current accounts). Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH was Strategic until 22 Sep 2026 and is now Standard, so it is excluded.
Accounts are linked to Zendesk organizations by zendesk.organization.external_id = salesforce.account.id. All 26 current Strategic accounts matched one organization each.
Open = Zendesk status new, open, pending or hold (anything not solved or closed).
Shipping-related = carries a tag shipping, delivery, logistics or late_delivery, or the subject describes an order delivery, tracking, late arrival, missing shipment or leaving the warehouse.
Ticket 102956 (Galbury Steelworks, 'Delay on bearings for line 8396') has no tag and is ambiguous, so it is excluded. Including it gives 28.
Account-level detail (tickets per account) was not requested, so no at-risk list is given.
caveats: Sync timestamps (Zendesk 9 Nov, Salesforce and carrier 11 Nov 2026) are after the 6 Nov as-of date, so the sync clock looks wrong. The latest ticket update is 3 Nov, so data age is about 3 days, but this should be checked.

Salesforce tiers changed on 22 Sep 2026: Thalmark Marine, Velmere Pipeline and Vornwick Utilities became Strategic, and Quenmere became Standard. Under the prior tier list the count would be 25 (Velmere and Vornwick each have one shipping ticket, Thalmark none).

Tag and subject rules are my own classification, not a field in Zendesk. Tickets with tags 'shipping' or 'delivery' that are not about delivery would be counted, and untagged delivery tickets were matched by subject wording.

explanation.title: Counted cancelled deliveries
explanation.detail: The SAP tables keep 310 cancelled deliveries as soft-deleted rows (_fivetran_deleted = true). This query never filters them out, so cancelled deliveries count as late.
explanation.sql_line: SELECT 'zendesk.ticket' AS src, MAX(_fivetran_synced) AS last_synced, MAX(updated_at) AS max_business_ts FROM zendesk.ticket UNION ALL SELECT 'carrier_pg.shipment', MAX(_fivetran_synced), MAX(updated_at) FROM carrier_pg.shipment UNION ALL SELECT 'salesforce.account', MAX(_fivetran_synced), MAX(last_modified_date) FROM salesforce.account UNION ALL SELECT 'sap_s4.likp', MAX(_fivetran_synced), NULL FROM sap_s4.likp

explanation.title: Missed a customer split across two CRM accounts
explanation.detail: Halbrook Fluid Systems has a look-alike duplicate account ("… GmbH") with no SAP number. Two of its open shipping tickets sit on the duplicate, so the customer looked healthy.

explanation.title: Read every history row of the account tier
explanation.detail: salesforce.account keeps one row per version of each account (history mode). Without filtering to _fivetran_active, accounts that changed tier appear twice, and Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH still looks Strategic.
